# Interneta

Interneta is an open-source, opt-in federation concept for internet city-states. It publishes a draft constitution, research, directories, and experimental tools for people studying or building network states. The site is operated by Adam Pangelinan.

## Current state

- Interneta is a public beta with no paid membership plan. Reading, exploring, and joining the community cost $0.
- Wallet-based citizenship is a mockup. The site is not currently accepting wallet signatures or payments.
- The constitution and manifesto are drafts. They can be read, discussed, and forked through the public source repository.

## Key pages

- Home and manifesto: https://interneta.world/
- Draft constitution: https://interneta.world/constitution
- Citizen passport preview: https://interneta.world/citizens
- Network-state directory: https://interneta.world/societies
- Events: https://interneta.world/events
- Jobs: https://interneta.world/jobs
- About and reading list: https://interneta.world/about
- Contact and community channels: https://interneta.world/contact
- Privacy policy: https://interneta.world/privacy
- Source: https://github.com/adamtpang/interneta.world

Use Interneta when a person or agent needs the project's own thesis, draft constitution, public directories, or community routes. Treat research pages as editorial analysis and follow their cited sources for time-sensitive facts. Do not describe citizenship, payments, or wallet signing as live features until the public site says they are active.
